items.question: Who can attend Thrive?
items.answer: Thrive is for women ages sixteen and older. You don’t need to call Christ Community Church your church home in order to join us.

items.question: Can I attend just one day?
items.answer: No, there are no single-day tickets available. One $80 ticket covers Friday night and Saturday morning.

items.question: Can I register a group?
items.answer: Each person registers individually. There is no group rate available. Send your friends the link and have each of them grab a ticket!

items.question: Is there a registration deadline?
items.answer: Registration stays open until tickets sell out.

items.question: Where should I park?
items.answer: Parking wraps around the whole building. Use the front entrance on the northwest corner, by the circle drive. [See the parking map](#parking).

items.question: Is food provided?
items.answer: Yes, but not full meals. A dessert bar follows Friday’s session, and refreshments are available during Saturday’s break. These are included with your ticket.

items.question: Who leads worship?
items.answer: The CCC Worship Team leads worship during the conference.

items.question: Will there be merch?
items.answer: Yes, Thrive and Lisa Harper merchandise will be available for purchase at the event. Pre-ordering is not available.

items.question: Can I help someone else attend?
items.answer: Yes! Add a scholarship gift of $25 or more when you register, and it will go toward another attendee’s ticket.
